dynamic_adapters.source: A Content Factory run result stored with an error object keeps that object's own error_code (content_factory_refusal_code, a bounded string); it fills only an empty error_code and never replaces one. Strict B1 metadata still goes through validate_failure/resolve_failure before policy.

A Content Factory 4xx refusal that is not an explicit dispatch_rejected records the refusal's own error_code (content_factory_refusal_code, a bounded string) so the registry and journey can map it (A18). Strict B1 metadata still goes through validate_failure/resolve_failure before policy.
